mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the capillary sprout was most worthwhile: the flowing blood made the new supply route clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and then fitting the supporting fibres felt a little repetitive, even though the separate pictures showed where they went.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the clot to be cleared after the skin closed; it helped show that the clot was temporary.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The wound messengers were a named pairing, but the picture showed them reaching the vessel and a branch growing.

continue.text: I'd probably continue for another chapter: seeing separate pieces become a working repair was satisfying, though some preparation-and-fitting steps felt repetitive.
